scope: diagnosis only; no acquisition, installed counterfactual, runtime-law modification, threshold change, or production promotion

data.old_development: 64 saved S2 development trials for input path and causal interventions
data.historical_admission: 16 immutable journal commands with original fit/check sets and witness state
data.final_holdout: never semantically loaded or evaluated; bytes only authenticated as archive payloads
data.synthetic_diagnostic: known linear target .1 + .2 * one forecast/history coordinate; not evidence of actual prediction-error information or independent generalization

causal_interventions.linear_feature: zero incoming direction; keep existing center, resolution and downstream graph
causal_interventions.product_feature: coarsen to resolution 7.99 and center zero; explicitly not a perfect zero clamp
causal_interventions.coordinate: zero each coordinate 0 through 69 without refitting

counterfactual_basis.capacity: at most one added feature; retain native ceiling 32; never install
counterfactual_basis.interpretation: candidate proposals outside the native single residual direction; score with native fit and retention functions

completion: DIAGNOSED, PARTIAL, INCONCLUSIVE or BLOCKED based on causal evidence; successful test exit is only engineering validation
source_integrity: verify full payload manifest before and after; assert exact runtime bytes before and after each detached diagnostic; exact replay must reproduce continuation
